news.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 to Feature Expanded Format and Venues
news.lede: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is poised to mark a significant change in the tournament's history, with an expanded format and host locations across three nations: the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The tournament will feature 48 teams, an increase from the traditional 32, which was in place for previous competitions. This adjustment represents FIFA's aim to enhance the global nature of the event, allowing more nations to participate. As a result, the tournament will consist of 80 matches, up from the previous count of 64.

news.title: Trent Alexander-Arnold's offer to Thomas Tuchel after England World Cup squad snub
news.lede: Trent Alexander-Arnold has told Thomas Tuchel that he's always available for selection for England. The first Three Lions squad of the season will be announced today (Friday, September 18) ahead of the Nations League later this month. The Real Madrid defender was among several high-profile omissions from England's World Cup squad this past summer after a difficult first season in Spain. Alexander-Arnold, 27, has yet to lay a marker down at the Santiago Bernabeu and has started just one league game this season under new manager Jose Mourinho.

news.title: Popovic swings axe on Socceroos skipper as Asian Cup auditions begin
news.lede: Updated September 18, 2026 - 1.26am. First published at 1.12am. Mat Ryan may have already played his last game for the Socceroos after he failed to make the 26-player squad for the side’s upcoming friendlies against Brazil. Tony Popovic named seven uncapped players in his line-up for the games later this month, while 16 members of his impressive World Cup squad were recalled.

news.title: Seven potential debutants called up for CommBank Socceroos' Brazil matches
news.lede: They join 16 players who were part of the Socceroos' FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign, six of whom (Patrick Beach, Paul Okon-Engstler, Jackson Irvine, Lucas Herrington, Nestory Irankunda and Alessandro Circati) have transferred to new clubs since the World Cup campaign. Eli Adams (Gamba Osaka), Kealey Adamson (QPR), Jacob Chapman (St Mirren), Yaya Dukuly (NK Celje) and Marcus Younis (Brondby IF) have been called into their maiden Socceroos camps. Uncapped players Kasey Bos (Excelsior Rotterdam) and Dylan Leonard (Alemannia Aachen) have been called up, having been selected in previous camps under CommBank Socceroos Head Coach Tony Popovic. Midfielders Riley McGree (Middlesbrough) and Patrick Yazbek (Nashville SC) have been recalled after missing the FIFA World Cup 2026 through injury.

news.title: FA chair urges FIFA president to release documents over controversial World Cup plan
news.lede: London, Sepr.17 (SANA) Football Association (FA) chair Debbie Hewitt has called on FIFA President Gianni Infantino to release all documents related to his abandoned plan to sell a stake in a new commercial company managing World Cup and other tournament rights. In a letter sent to Infantino and FIFA Secretary General Mattias Grafström, Hewitt, who is also a FIFA vice-president, requested that the FIFA Council receive a written explanation for the decision to suspend the one-match ban imposed on US forward Folarin Balogun during the World Cup. Hewitt asked FIFA to make the documents available before the next FIFA Council meeting scheduled for Oct. 15, citing concerns over governance and the organisation’s internal culture. Scrapped commercial proposal sparks controversy.

news.title: Man City-bound wonderkid, 16, handed USMNT call-up in new era after World Cup humbling
news.lede: The 16-year-old was named in Mauricio Pochettino's United States national team squad for the upcoming international break. The make-up of the 28-man roster very much signifies a new era for the USMNT, with 12 players receiving their first call-up. Adding to the freshness of the squad is that the average age of those called up is 22 years and nine months. That is aided by the fact six players in the squad are aged 18 or under, including Sullivan, who turns 17 on September 28.
